idea-plugin.name: CrunchGuard
idea-plugin.description:
CrunchGuard — walk to unlock your IDE.

Embeds the CrunchGuard dashboard as a JCEF tool window, tracks REAL editor keystroke activity to fill the crunch meter, and when crunch time hits it forces a walking break: a QR code appears, your phone counts steps, progress syncs live through the plugin's built-in relay server (no Node.js needed). Completing the walk unlocks the IDE with "Crunch Break Verified! +100 Mana".

This is the plugin variant of CrunchGuard. The standalone variant (runs in a normal browser with a Node server) lives in the without-plugin folder of the same repository.
